author: Corridor Crew
description:
Emmy-nominated VFX Supervisor Marion Spates, known for his work on Stranger Things, WandaVision, Lost in Space, and the newest TV show Avatar: The Last Airbender, is here to share a gamechanger tip on rotoscoping.

Can you believe his very first VFX job was rotoscoping Matthew McConaughey in Reign of Fire?
title: What makes a good ROTOSCOPE?
